dedupe_keys.name: neep cold climate air source heat pump ccashp specification and product list

description: NEEP maintains the Cold Climate Air Source Heat Pump Specification and the product list of heat pumps that meet it, used by efficiency programme administrators as a qualification requirement and by engineers and contractors who need assurance that equipment will heat efficiently across the ambient temperature range in cold climates (IECC climate zone 4 and higher). NEEP explains that the federal HSPF metric has no test points below 17 F, assumes electric resistance back-up and tests steady-state operation, so the specification sets performance and reporting requirements at low temperatures. Version 4.0, effective 1 January 2023, covers central air-conditioning heat pumps, variable refrigerant flow multi-split heat pumps and packaged terminal and single package vertical heat pumps under AHRI standards 210/240, 1230, 310/380 and 390; version 5.0 and a room heat pump specification are in development. Coverage: products sold in the US and Canada. Access: free online list. Licence: NEEP terms of use. Caveats: on 1 April NEEP moved data collection to AHRI and warned that some eligible products were not yet reported, so the list may be incomplete. Simulation uses: low-temperature capacity and efficiency inputs for heat pump sizing and electrification models. Related records: ENERGY STAR certified products data and the Eurovent Certified Product Directory.
